# IsItWP

> > IsItWP is a free WordPress theme and plugin detector tool combined with comprehensive guides for building websites, blogs, and online stores with WordPress.

IsItWP provides both a powerful detection tool for identifying WordPress themes and plugins on any website, and an extensive library of tutorials, reviews, and comparisons for WordPress beginners and entrepreneurs. The site covers everything from website creation to ecommerce setup, with expert recommendations for hosting providers, plugins, themes, and business tools.
